title: Reciting Surah al-Qadr at Suhoor & Iftar
description: A powerful narration from Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) comparing the one who recites Surah al-Qadr at both Suhoor and Iftar to a martyr rolling in their blood for the sake of Allah.

phrases.english: At the time of the pre-dawn meal,

phrases.arabic: عن الإمام الصادق عليه السلام قال:
phrases.english: It is narrated from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) that he said:

phrases.arabic: مَا مِنْ مُؤْمِنٍ صَامَ فَقَرأ «إنّا أنْزَلْناهُ في لَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ» عِنْدَ سُحُورِهِ وعِنْدَ إفْطَارِهِ إلّاكانَ فِيما بَيْنَهُما كالمُتَشَحِّطِ بِدَمِه في سَبيلِ اللَّهِ»
phrases.english: No believer fasts and recites "Indeed, We revealed it on the Night of Decree" at the time of his pre-dawn meal and at the time of breaking his fast, but that he remains during the interval between them like one wallowing in his blood for the sake of Allah.
phrases.transliteration: Mā min mu’minin ṣāma fa-qara’a «Innā anzalnāhu fī laylati l-qadr» ‘inda suḥūrihi wa-‘inda ifṭārihi illā kāna fīmā baynahumā ka-l-mutašaḥḥiṭi bi-damihi fī sabīli-llāh.
